subject: Fix format issues with CVE fix (#2679)
reason: The change is purely cosmetic: it reformats whitespace and switch-case indentation in luaSetTableProtectionForBasicTypes in src/lua/script_lua.c with byte-for-byte identical semantics (same pushed values, same loop, same calls), and adds an external:skip tag to one TCL test. No server behavior, reply, protocol, persistence or replication path differs between the parent and head builds, so a compared sequence or fault scenario would find no reachable difference.
